title: A Primal Approach to Facial Reduction for SDP Relaxations of Combinatorial Optimization Problems
summary: We propose a novel facial reduction algorithm tailored to semidefinite programming relaxations of combinatorial optimization problems with quadratic objective functions. Our method leverages the specific structure of these relaxations, particularly the availability of feasible solutions that can often be generated efficiently in practice. By incorporating such solutions into the facial reduction process, we substantially simplify the reduction steps.
